s1.syndrome_frame: Pelvic mass with pelvic pain and urinary frequency
salient_findings: 9.4 cm heterogeneous lesion involving the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass encasing the right external iliac artery
key_facts: 54-year-old woman
History of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma
Treated with mastectomy and chemoradiation 4 years earlier
Presenting with urinary frequency
Worsening right-sided pelvic pain
Weight loss
MRI of the pelvis showed multiple fibroids and a heterogeneous 9.4 cm lesion
Mass involved the right uterine fundus/cornua
Mass encased the right external iliac artery
Specimen was a detached, fragmented, ill-defined mass with fleshy solid and cystic components
Central hemorrhage and necrosis were present
Tumor invaded from the serosal surface into the myometrium
High nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and frequent mitoses were observed
Immunohistochemical stains showed diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1

differentials: Perivascular epithelioid cell neoplasm (PEComa) with malignant behavior
Uterine tumor resembling ovarian sex cord-stromal tumor
Low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma with high-grade transformation
Small cell carcinoma of the uterus
Transitional cell carcinoma of the uterus
Uterine carcinosarcoma with small cell component

Small cell carcinoma of the uterus
Transitional cell carcinoma of the uterus

shortlist.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: High-grade tumor with high mitotic rate and necrosis, consistent with leiomyosarcoma

shortlist.label: Ewing sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diffuse positivity for CD99 and small, round, hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios

shortlist.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Small, round, hyperchromatic cells and desmoplastic stroma, with positivity for CD99 and KIT

shortlist.label: Uterine carcinosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Heterogeneous mass with fleshy solid and cystic components, and history of breast cancer

shortlist.label: Endometrial stromal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Tumor invading from serosal surface into myometrium, with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and frequent mitoses

raw.rationale: The tumor's microscopic features, including small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses, and pseudo-rosette formation, along with immunohistochemical stains showing diffuse positivity for CD99, are characteristic of desmoplastic small round cell tumor.

rejected.label: Uterine leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Lack of typical smooth muscle differentiation and absence of desmin and myogenin positivity

rejected.label: Ewing sarcoma
rejected.why: While Ewing sarcoma can express CD99, the clinical presentation and other immunohistochemical stains do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Uterine carcinosarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's morphology and immunohistochemical profile do not suggest a carcinomatous component

rejected.label: Endometrial stromal sarcoma
rejected.why: The tumor's morphology and immunohistochemical stains, including negativity for CD10 and ER/PR, do not support this diagnosis
